purpose: Post-hoc matched detector diagnosis after the COCO-initialized pilot missed seq8 and seq11 initialization frames. Compare the existing PolypGen detector and the pilot checkpoint on the identical C6 still-image validation set, without any video re-detection.
scope: All 88 previously curated C6 validation images, selected before this comparison. C6 was used to select the pilot checkpoint, so the results are optimistic and not independent testing. The original detector's training split is unknown and may include C6. Patient, source-video and near-duplicate overlap are unverified. There are only five labeled-empty still images.
inference: Generate a label-free manifest containing only image paths, hashes, dimensions and fixed dataset IDs. For each still image, run each model once in a fresh CPU FP32 process with the same existing conf=0.25, IoU=0.7, imgsz=640, class=0 and highest-confidence-box procedure as the original automatic initialization. No target/video detector calls, new threshold, gate, re-detection or sequence propagation. Repeat both-model predictions independently; freeze and verify before opening C6 box or mask labels.
metrics: For labeled-present still images, report detector proposal rate, best IoU against any supplied GT box and proportion of labeled mask pixels inside the predicted box; report absent detections as zero overlap. Report labeled-empty detector false alarms with the five-image denominator. Metrics are image-level top-one summaries, not COCO mAP. Compare matched image differences descriptively; do not use test labels to tune settings. Full-video promotion remains disallowed without stronger evidence.
verification: Check original and candidate checkpoint hashes against prior independent gates, original smoke test and trained-model validation; prove engineering predictions repeat on two preselected C6 images without labels; rerun full set twice and independently verify all input/box/confidence hashes and parameter stability. Score labels only after frozen predictions, then independently recompute IoU, coverage and false alarms. All outputs are on Google Drive.
